'''Horace Vancil''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They served on the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] between [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].

==Biography==
Vancil was the Queen's political and economic [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], often giving information about [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] economy and keeping an eye out for political crises.<ref name="CCG" /> Their wardrobe included a heavy, black overcoat with voluminous sleeves. Vancil was present in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] disrupted the communication signal of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Ironically, although a political crisis was occurring, Vancil kept their own council, allowing [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] to share his insights.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], they succeeded the xenophobe [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] as Senator of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], although Greejatus had only held the office two years. Vancil's open-mindedness was more in touch with the interspecies-integrated society on Naboo following the treaty between Queen Amidala and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]]. Vancil was eventually replaced by Amidala herself<ref name="Janus Greejatus" /> in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Strangely, most reference sources that name and show the Royal advisors overlook this character. They are named by the CCG and can clearly be seen on the Council in the movie. ''Secrets of Naboo'' inaccurately states that the Royal Advisory Council has five members. In the movie, there are clearly six. Vancil cannot be seen at the Celebration Parade, probably because this was one of the last scenes filmed.

The name for Horace Vancil comes from the Star Wars CCG when employee Joseph Alreed was coming up with names for cards and used the last name of his friend Phil Vancil. It was thought that the first name Phil didn't sound appropriate to the Star Wars universe and Horace was fabricated instead.
